screen_count_note: 21 proposed learner screens. This is NOT derived from B02's 29 — B02 is a different unit with 14 extracted photographs and a different structure. T04's count falls out of its own source: three operations with two sub-screens each, three compliance screens forced apart by the D-04 split, and one stepped process screen.

screens.instructional_purpose: Open the unit and give the learner the topic and Bahagian before anything else.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner knows which Topik and Bahagian they are in.
screens.base_state: Title, unit name and a MULA button, all visible.
screens.narration_treatment: One short screen-level VO naming the course, Topik and Bahagian.
screens.speaker_notes_treatment: NON_SPOKEN_CONTEXT: unit provenance. SPOKEN_CONTENT_VO: the welcome line.
screens.accessibility_treatment: The MULA button must be keyboard reachable and labelled.

screens.instructional_purpose: Open from the site at the moment construction ends and maintenance begins, so the six activities arrive as work rather than as a diagram.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can say what the maintenance phase covers and that it splits into soft and hard landscape.
screens.base_state: Site visual with both characters; dialogue plays as character video, full text in Notes.
screens.narration_treatment: Dialogue is the audio. No separate narrator VO.
screens.speaker_notes_treatment: NON_SPOKEN_CONTEXT: unit provenance. SPOKEN_CONTENT_VO: the five turns. PRODUCTION_INSTRUCTION_NOT_SPOKEN: character direction and the compliance-exclusion rule.
screens.accessibility_treatment: Full dialogue must exist as attributed text, not audio only.

screens.instructional_purpose: Present the six supervisory activities in source order and give each one a visual, as Bariah ruled.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can name the six activities and place them in order.
screens.base_state: The source-bound six-step diagram with all six labels visible from the start.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO plus a short line per step.
screens.speaker_notes_treatment: PRODUCTION_INSTRUCTION_NOT_SPOKEN: D-05 redraw rule — six nodes, linear, no hierarchy.
screens.completion_condition: all six steps viewed; the six labels are already in the base state
screens.accessibility_treatment: The six labels must be selectable text, not only pixels inside an image.

screens.instructional_purpose: Establish the soft-landscape category before its three operations are taught.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can say what soft landscape includes.
screens.base_state: Category visual and the source definition, both visible.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO.

screens.instructional_purpose: Give watering a concrete image and its purpose before methods are broken down.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can state why watering is done.
screens.base_state: Operation visual and the source definition.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO.

screens.instructional_purpose: Contrast manual watering with automatic irrigation, and inside automatic, sprinkler with drip.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can choose an irrigation method for a given situation.
screens.base_state: Both method labels visible; the comparison composite is the persistent visual.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per method.
screens.accessibility_treatment: Reveals keyboard reachable and state announced; stacked fallback loses nothing.

screens.instructional_purpose: Cover the four management topics the source groups under contractor responsibility.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can state the contractor's watering-management duties.
screens.base_state: Four topic labels visible before any interaction.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per topic.

screens.instructional_purpose: Give fertilising a concrete image and its purpose.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can state why fertiliser is applied.
screens.base_state: Operation visual and the source definition.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO.

screens.instructional_purpose: Distinguish the three application methods the source names.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can match an application method to a planting situation.
screens.base_state: Three method labels visible; the comparison composite is the persistent visual.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per method.

screens.instructional_purpose: Cover the five management topics the source groups under contractor responsibility.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can state the contractor's fertilising-management duties.
screens.base_state: Five topic labels visible before any interaction.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per topic.
screens.technical_claim_dependency: T04-ROW-039 names the Pegawai Penguasa (S.O.) approval requirement — quoted, not asserted.

screens.instructional_purpose: Establish that pest control addresses three different problems, not one.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can name the three threats pest control addresses.
screens.base_state: Three-threat visual and the source definition.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO.

screens.instructional_purpose: Teach the IPM priority order — that chemical control is not the first response.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can place chemical control last in the IPM priority order.
screens.base_state: The priority-order diagram persistent, with all four control names visible.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per control.
screens.accessibility_treatment: The order must be conveyed by text and structure, not by colour alone.

screens.instructional_purpose: Pair each pesticide type with the problem it controls.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can match pesticide type to target.
screens.base_state: The three-type comparison visible as the persistent visual.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per type.

screens.instructional_purpose: Carry the statutory control and the licensed-operator requirement, both base-visible.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can state who may legally carry out pesticide spraying.
screens.base_state: Statute and licensed-operator requirement verbatim, both visible. NOTHING on this screen is behind an interaction.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO; the obligations are spoken as written.
screens.speaker_notes_treatment: PRODUCTION_INSTRUCTION_NOT_SPOKEN: this screen carries legal content and must not be abbreviated in MMD.
screens.accessibility_treatment: Legal content reachable without interaction, and not dependent on colour or hover.
screens.technical_claim_dependency: T04-CLM-01 Akta Racun Makhluk Perosak 1974 and T04-CLM-02 licensed operator — both EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED, quoted verbatim, never paraphrased.

screens.instructional_purpose: Carry full PPE on the base screen, with storage and SDS detail reveal-eligible under the D-04 ruling.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can state the PPE required and where pesticide must be stored.
screens.base_state: PPE Lengkap and its item list VISIBLE — Bariah placed PPE on the base screen.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level VO; PPE spoken on the base state.
screens.speaker_notes_treatment: PRODUCTION_INSTRUCTION_NOT_SPOKEN: D-04 split — PPE may not be moved behind a reveal.
screens.completion_condition: screen viewed; the base state already discharges the PPE disclosure
screens.technical_claim_dependency: T04-CLM-03 PPE and T04-CLM-04 SDS — quoted verbatim.

screens.instructional_purpose: Carry the risk-management heading on the base screen with spray conditions, notification and reporting reveal-eligible under the D-04 ruling.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can state the conditions under which spraying may proceed.
screens.base_state: The Pengurusan Risiko heading visible so the learner knows the topic exists.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per obligation.
screens.speaker_notes_treatment: PRODUCTION_INSTRUCTION_NOT_SPOKEN: D-04 made these three reveal-eligible; a non-interacting learner will not see them, which is recorded as a residual risk.
screens.accessibility_treatment: Reveals keyboard reachable and state announced.

screens.instructional_purpose: Establish the hard-landscape category and its contrast with soft landscape.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can distinguish soft from hard landscape.
screens.base_state: Category visual and the source definition.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO.

screens.instructional_purpose: Present the four functions hard landscape performs, each with its two source sub-items.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can name the four functions and give an example of each.
screens.base_state: Four group labels visible before any interaction.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction plus one line per group.

screens.instructional_purpose: Recap the unit in four points, in the Topik 3 Bahagian 2 style Bariah instructed.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner can restate the unit's structure and the contractor's responsibilities.
screens.base_state: Heading and four recap points, all visible.
screens.narration_treatment: One screen-level VO reading the recap.
screens.technical_claim_dependency: None — the Rumusan deliberately says 'perundangan' rather than naming an Act.

screens.instructional_purpose: Assess the unit with four MCQ and one Multiple Response, at a 60 percent pass mark.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner demonstrates recall and application across the unit's coverage.
screens.base_state: Five items presented in sequence.
screens.narration_treatment: Screen-level instruction only; no VO reads the questions aloud.
screens.speaker_notes_treatment: PRODUCTION_INSTRUCTION_NOT_SPOKEN: pass mark 60 percent, scope all PLs in the Kursus.
screens.accessibility_treatment: Options keyboard reachable; feedback not conveyed by colour alone.
screens.technical_claim_dependency: Q5 draws on rows carrying EXTERNAL_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED claims; no option names the Act.

screens.instructional_purpose: Close the unit and confirm completion.
screens.learner_outcome: The learner knows the Bahagian is complete.
screens.base_state: Closing statement, visible.
screens.narration_treatment: One short closing VO.
